 Live Results: Texas Senate midterm election
 Politics 
 Nov 3, 2026 9:30 AM EST
 WATCH LIVE: Election night 2026 PBS News special coverage 
 The U.S. Senate race in Texas between Republican Ken Paxton and Democrat James Talarico is widely considered the marquee race of the midterm cycle.
 READ MORE: Paxton and Talarico tussle for Texas Senate seat as Trump campaigns virtually 
 Paxton, the state's three-term attorney general, was impeached by the Texas House in 2023 and acquitted by the state Senate. With President Donald Trump's endorsement a week before the vote, he beat Sen. John Cornyn in a May primary runoff, the first time a Texas senator has lost renomination since 1970.
 Stand with free and independent journalism. Join Press Pass from PBS News 
 Talarico is a state representative from the Austin suburbs, a former middle school teacher and a seminarian. He beat Rep. Jasmine Crockett outright in the March primary and has built his campaign around faith, public schools and cost of living.
 No Democrat has won statewide in Texas since 1994. In recent polling, Paxton has trailed behind Talarico.
 -- Matt Loffman
